privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.body: The VICE VERSA app collects no personal data. A random token stored in your browser links your answers during the workshop. There is no name, email, phone number or location. Free texts are reviewed by the team before being shown and limited to 140 characters. Raw answers are deleted after 12 months; only aggregated results are kept. A technical cookie only serves to recover your session if your browser forgets it.
